title: The Ra channelings and the Law of One

tellings.quote: through the raw channelings that Bharich was involved in with Carla Rukert who published the raw material and the law of one.

plain: In the 1980s, a being calling itself Ra is said to have spoken through a human medium in sessions called channelings, where a person in trance passes on messages from a nonhuman source, and these messages became a teaching known as the Law of One. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove mentions it to Michels, saying the sessions involved a man he names Bharich and Carla Rueckert, who published them as the Ra Material and The Law of One.
